HOUSTON, Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- NOV Inc. (NYSE: NOV) will hold a conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 10 a.m. (Central Time). NOV will issue a press release with the Company’s results after the market closes for trading on Tuesday, October 27, 2026. The call will be webcast live on[www.nov.com/investors](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zWR98-i_GwqYu6J1PATwVt_rU62W3ayFTbsW-LfhWyovPB_0s4o8Ru4y6Eo6BVdUQWvLzTWivBURjQBSUcpLugjVLIpKPF0JRLHuyfvx1FM=) .


**About NOV**
NOV delivers technology-driven solutions to empower the global energy industry. For more than 150 years, NOV has pioneered innovations that enable its customers to safely and efficiently produce abundant energy while minimizing environmental impact. NOV powers the industry that powers the world.


Visit[www.nov.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zWR98-i_GwqYu6J1PATwVlvoWXDsjtho7qD_hSs6jSPIFokHfXw_JsFBl4dC2mLPSA0ARBPrrUT-ZoBlJuMBHg==) for more information.


Source: NOV Inc.
